en.title: One euro only... Kim Kardashian compensation after armed robbery incident in Paris
en.summary: A French court awarded reality television personality Kim Kardashian symbolic damages of one euro following an armed robbery she experienced in Paris years earlier.

stories.title: Russian drone strike on a passenger bus in Ukraine kills 5 people and wounds at least 7 others

en.title: Russian drone strike on a passenger bus in Ukraine kills 5 people and wounds at least 7 others
en.summary: A Russian drone strike hit a passenger bus in southern Ukraine's Nikopol district, killing five people and injuring at least seven others. President Zelenskyy condemned the attack.

stories.title: Egypt’s El-Sisi rejects displacement of Palestinians, vows continued efforts on Gaza deal

en.title: Egypt's El-Sisi rejects displacement of Palestinians, vows continued efforts on Gaza deal
en.summary: Egyptian President El-Sisi reaffirmed opposition to Palestinian displacement and committed to ongoing mediation efforts to implement a Gaza ceasefire agreement during talks with Palestinian leader Mahmoud Abbas.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia's Hostile Drone Targeting Makkah

en.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia's Hostile Drone Targeting Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned the Houthi militia for a hostile drone operation targeting Makkah.

stories.title: Aramco leads global Q2 dividend rankings as Saudi Arabia places 8th

en.title: Aramco leads global Q2 dividend rankings as Saudi Arabia places 8th
en.summary: Saudi Aramco was the world's largest corporate dividend payer in the second quarter of 2026. Saudi Arabian companies distributed $28.4 billion in dividends, with the Kingdom ranking eighth globally among national markets.

stories.title: Egypt's Sisi Rejects Palestinian Displacement in Abbas Meeting

en.title: Egypt's Sisi Rejects Palestinian Displacement in Abbas Meeting
en.summary: Egypt's Sisi rejected Palestinian displacement during a meeting with Abbas.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia asserts right to take all necessary measures after Houthi drone attack on Makkah

en.title: Saudi Arabia asserts right to take all necessary measures after Houthi drone attack on Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned a Houthi drone attack on Makkah and stated it reserves the right to take necessary defensive measures to protect the Two Holy Mosques and their pilgrims.

stories.title: MWL Condemns Houthi Militia Attacks on Makkah, Madinah

en.title: MWL Condemns Houthi Militia Attacks on Makkah, Madinah
en.summary: The Muslim World League condemned Houthi militia attacks targeting Makkah and Madinah.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, other Muslim countries condemn Houthi attempt to attack Makkah

en.title: Saudi Arabia, other Muslim countries condemn Houthi attempt to attack Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia and other Muslim nations condemned a Houthi drone attack targeting Makkah. Officials characterized the incident as a terrorist attack and violation of holy sites that provokes Muslim sentiment worldwide.

stories.title: Yemen, Pakistan, Kuwait, OIC and MWL condemn Houthi attacks on Makkah

en.title: Yemen, Pakistan, Kuwait, OIC and MWL condemn Houthi attacks on Makkah
en.summary: Yemen, Pakistan, Kuwait, the Organization of Islamic Cooperation, and the Muslim World League condemned Houthi drone attacks on Makkah. The organizations expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia and support for protecting Islamic holy sites.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia warns Houthi Attacks threaten Red Sea navigation and Global Trade

en.title: Saudi Arabia warns Houthi Attacks threaten Red Sea navigation and Global Trade
en.summary: Saudi Arabia stated at the United Nations that Houthi attacks in the Red Sea and Bab Al-Mandab Strait pose risks to global maritime commerce and supply chains.

stories.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi drone south of Makkah

en.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi drone south of Makkah
en.summary: Saudi air defenses destroyed a Houthi drone south of Makkah on Tuesday evening before it could enter the city's restricted airspace. Coalition officials identified this as the second attempted attack on the holy city.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 10
en.summary: The Saudi stock exchange reported major ownership changes on September 10.

stories.title: ‎US oil inventories fall for 3rd straight week

en.title: US oil inventories fall for 3rd straight week
en.summary: United States crude oil inventories decreased for the third consecutive week ending September 11, though the decline was smaller than market forecasts. The draw reflects sustained oil demand amid Middle Eastern geopolitical tensions.

stories.title: ‎Edarat issues SAR 127.5M PO for computing infrastructure equipment

en.title: Edarat issues SAR 127.5M PO for computing infrastructure equipment
en.summary: Edarat Communications and Information Technology Co. issued a purchase order worth 127.54 million Saudi riyals for cloud and GPU computing infrastructure from Aklaniyat Technology. The equipment will be delivered and installed over six months through supplier financing and credit arrangements.

stories.title: ‎BAAN starts construction of Playocity project in Jeddah

en.title: BAAN starts construction of Playocity project in Jeddah
en.summary: BAAN Holding Group has begun construction of Playocity, an entertainment venue developed with Hasbro at Westfield Jeddah. The 2,600 square meter project will feature family-oriented entertainment combining games, interactive activities, and Hasbro-branded experiences for various age groups.

stories.title: ‎SIDC appoints financial advisor on Advanced Energy buyout

en.title: SIDC appoints financial advisor on Advanced Energy buyout
en.summary: Saudi Industrial Development Co. has engaged Alinma Capital as financial advisor for its proposed full acquisition of unlisted Advanced Energy Trading and Contracting Co. The transaction remains subject to valuation, due diligence, negotiations, and regulatory approvals.
